color: rgb(11, 60, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(6, 64, 43) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(90, 58, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(92, 34, 6) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(74, 59, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(79, 36, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(16, 42, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Sequence → ESM-C 600M
573,632,640 weights, all frozen:
572 effective targets cannot
fine-tune a model that size.

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Residue cache · 14 GiB
10,820 targets encoded once,
bit-for-bit reproducible.
Declares its own layer set.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 60, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SMILES → line graph
Each bond is a node. Two extra
nodes hold a 512-bit fingerprint
and 200 properties.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 60, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
LiGhT · 8 layers, width 96
Bonds attend to bonds five atoms
out. Attention kept for iBAM.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 60, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Summary → 288
Fingerprint, properties, mean
over bonds. Never blended.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 60, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Pre-training · done
540,166 training-only molecules.
Hide one knowledge node, rebuild it.
Held-out loss 0.2002, 48.8% under
a molecule-blind guess.

div.style: color: rgb(6, 64, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center; width: 420px;

span.p:
The seam · one vector per bond, plus two masks
Real-vs-padding, and drawable-vs-not. Knowledge nodes are real but not drawable,
and conflating the two is what forced them to be discarded before.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 60, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Protein → 160
1152 narrowed in one map.
Expand-then-contract cost
1,051,136 and was dropped.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 60, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(11, 60, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Summary → 3 × 160
Each part projected alone, so
the fingerprint is never
averaged in with properties.

div.style: color: rgb(90, 58, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
v2: assay conditions → 160
pH/temperature, IC50 tier, source.
IC50 is 72% of the corpus and is
not a constant of the pair.
Group ids excluded: they leak.

div.style: color: rgb(90, 58, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center; width: 420px;

span.p:
Knowledge + assay conditioning · FiLM · 145,088
Global properties rescale every residue and bond rather than being appended: an
appended vector can be ignored, a multiplied one cannot. Exact no-op at init.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 60, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Protein looks at ligand
160 → 320 → 160

div.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Two separate weight sets.
Neither sees the other's output,
and one is not the transpose
of the other.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 60, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Ligand looks at protein
160 → 320 → 160

div.style: color: rgb(11, 60, 82) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center; width: 420px;

span.p:
v2: pooled by relevance · 103,044 · 960 numbers, six blocks
A binding site is ~20-30 residues of a median 454, so v1 averaged the signal away
15 to 20 fold. Two heads score each residue now. Exactly the mean at init.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 60, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(11, 60, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(11, 60, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Trunk 960 → 160 → 160 is shared,
179,520 of the 180,003. Three whole
MLPs cost 918,528 more. Each endpoint
keeps its own output.

div.style: color: rgb(92, 34, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center; width: 420px;

span.p:
Score only the endpoint that was measured
Kd, Ki and IC50 are different experiments and are never mixed. A measurement that
does not exist gets no stand-in value, because no such value is representable.

div.style: color: rgb(74, 59, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Exact
Error under the lab's repeat
scatter is free: 0.945 Kd,
0.641 Ki, 0.671 IC50.

div.style: color: rgb(74, 59, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Censored · 18.5%
'Weaker than 10 µM'. Penalized
for crossing the bound, never
for landing inside it.

div.style: color: rgb(74, 59, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Lower-confidence
Weighted 0.25, kept apart so
they cannot reach the main term.

div.style: color: rgb(74, 59, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Which of two is better
Weight 0.1. Within one assay, and
only when the gap beats that
endpoint's repeat scatter.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 60, 82) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center; width: 420px;

span.p:
v1 measured · v2 training now
v1 on all 186,923 exact val labels, 95% intervals from a cluster bootstrap over
3,202 protein components: RMSE 1.2432 (1.220 to 1.268) · concordance 0.730 ·
Spearman 0.637 · AUROC 0.806 · AUPRC 0.749 on a 0.424 baseline.

An endpoint-mean guess scores 1.4437, the noise floor is 0.670: v1 captures
25.9% of the learnable span. Closing that gap is what v2 is for.

div.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
iBAM · unblocked
Every map per layer and head,
unaveraged: 32 protein-ligand,
64 bond-bond. Residue × bond is
native, residue × atom derived.

div.style: color: rgb(79, 36, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Ensemble · blocked
Needs three trained models.
Three passes over one is
refused in code.

div.style: color: rgb(79, 36, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Calibrated intervals · blocked
Split conformal. Waits on
seeds 2 and 3.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 60, 82) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Is this input familiar?
Similarity to training molecules
only: an ensemble can agree
confidently about the unseen.

div.style: color: rgb(92, 34, 6) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Benchmark lock
Refuses the sealed panels when training
overlaps them. Measured, not guessed:
random 60 to 100%, cold-target 66 to 69%,
time-based 0%. Opening cannot be undone.

div.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Drug fishing · an evaluation, not a part
3,721 targets · 81,971 actives · 37,187
measured inactives · 1,926,939 decoys.

div.style: color: rgb(79, 36, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
What it is told
Target, endpoint, seed molecule,
scaffold, and the wanted potency
change in noise-floor units.

div.style: color: rgb(79, 36, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Discrete graph diffusion
Corrupted by category, never by
Gaussian noise on a one-hot: carbon
is not between nitrogen and oxygen.

div.style: color: rgb(79, 36, 67) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Back to a molecule
Scaffold re-checked by atom
mapping, not substructure match.
Validity reported before and
after sanitizing.

svg.text: BINDRA-v2 · 2,590,851 trainable parameters · v1 measured, v2 training
